input.summary: Hit the black drop target, lock at the orbit saucer, then start two-ball 2x play at the guarded yellow standup. Focus on the spinner; finish a red bank only when one or two targets remain.

quickInfo.name: Lock qualification
quickInfo.summary: Hit the black drop target to light the orbit saucer lock for one ball.

quickInfo.name: Andromeda Multiball
quickInfo.summary: After a lock, hit the guarded yellow standup to release the ball and start two-ball play with 2x scoring.

quickInfo.name: 2x scoring
quickInfo.summary: Two-ball play doubles playfield scoring while both balls remain active.

quickInfo.name: Spinner value
quickInfo.summary: The first red-bank completion raises the spinner from 1K to 3K per spin, and the second raises it to 4K.

quickInfo.name: Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Complete top-lane sets to raise Bonus X through 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, and 10x on a base bonus worth up to 80K.

steps.text: Hit the black drop target to light lock.
Shoot the orbit saucer to lock one ball. A later player can steal an unclaimed lock, so convert it on the same ball when possible.
Hit the guarded yellow standup to start Andromeda Multiball and 2x scoring.
modeNotes: Andromeda Multiball: The black target lights the orbit lock. After the lock, the guarded yellow target releases the held ball for two-ball play.
2x scoring: Normal playfield scoring is doubled while both balls remain in play.

steps.text: During two-ball play, focus on the spinner. Finish the red bank only when one or two targets remain; the first two completions raise the spinner to 3K and 4K.
modeNotes: Read the current spinner value and Bonus X before deciding whether to finish a red bank or top-lane set.

steps.text: Let spinner and upper-playfield returns complete top-lane sets and advance Bonus X toward 10x.
After multiball, rebuild the black-target lock route before another player can benefit from a staged ball.

fallback.title: Spinner and top bonus
fallback.when: Use this when the lock saucer or guarded start target is unsafe.

steps.text: Finish the red drop bank only when one or two targets remain and their rebounds are controlled.
Repeat the spinner from a controlled flipper.
Use top-lane feeds to raise Bonus X toward 10x.
Return to the lock route only after the orbit and yellow-target returns are known.

alternatives.title: Fast 2x conversion
alternatives.when: Use this when a lock is already staged and the yellow target is safe.

steps.text: Do not delay the lock for full spinner or bonus preparation.
Hit the guarded yellow standup to start two-ball 2x play.
Use the protection to finish red banks and top lanes.
Complete successive red drop banks until the spinner reaches 4K.
Complete top-lane groups until Bonus X reaches 10x.
Start two-ball 2x scoring to protect the dangerous progress shots.
Carry the multiplied bonus to the end of the ball.

techniques.name: Orbit-to-lock setup
techniques.instruction: Trap before the orbit shot. Use the full orbit only when it reaches the saucer cleanly and does not reject from its entrance.

techniques.name: Multiball spinner control
techniques.instruction: Trap one ball when possible. Use the other ball to repeat the spinner after the red banks raise its value.

cautions.issue: The multiball start is a guarded standup and can rebound toward the center.
cautions.response: Shoot it from a cradle. Keep the opposite flipper ready for the rebound.

cautions.issue: A missed orbit-saucer shot can hit the lane divider and return unpredictably.
cautions.response: Test the orbit before committing to repeated locks. Use spinner and bonus play when it rejects.

cautions.issue: A locked ball can remain available for the next player.
cautions.response: After locking, start two-ball play on the same ball when the guarded target is controllable.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm balls per game, Extra Ball and Special treatment, feature memory, and whether a physical lock is shared between players.
Read the current spinner value and Bonus X before deciding whether to finish a red bank or top-lane set.
Test the orbit-saucer entry, guarded launch target, lock release, right-lane return, spinner feed, and red-target rebounds.
